scholarships.title: NL Scholarship (formerly known as Holland Scholarship)
scholarships.official_source: Nuffic (Netherlands Organisation for Internationalisation in Education)

existing.funding_period: one-off award paid in the first year of study
existing.description: The NL Scholarship, renamed from the Holland Scholarship, is financed by the Dutch Ministry of Education, Culture and Science together with participating Dutch research universities and universities of applied sciences. It awards EUR 5,000 to non-EEA students starting a full-time bachelor's or master's programme at a participating institution, paid during the first year of study, and the official page states it is not a full-tuition scholarship. Applicants apply directly to the participating institution, which publishes the eligible fields of study and its own closing date. Nuffic publishes the annual list of participating institutions for each academic year.
eligibility: You are applying for a full-time bachelor's or master's programme at one of the participating Dutch higher education institutions
You meet the specific requirements of the institution of your choice (set out on that institution's website)
You do not have a degree from an education institution in the Netherlands
existing.eligibility_summary: International (non-EEA) students applying full-time to a participating Dutch institution, with no degree from a Dutch education institution.
benefits: EUR 5,000 awarded once, in the first year of the programme
coverage: One-off cash award of EUR 5,000 paid in the first year of study
requirements: Submit the application through the participating institution of your choice
Meet that institution's programme-specific entry and scholarship requirements
Comply with Nuffic's Code of Conduct for Integrity
existing.english_requirement: Applications are submitted directly to the participating Dutch institution, which sets the language requirements for its own programmes.
application_method: Apply directly to a participating Dutch institution using that institution's own scholarship application form
Check the institution's website for the eligible fields of study and the closing date
existing.selection_notes: Selection is made by the participating institution according to its own criteria; the national programme sets only the financial award and the general eligibility rules.
existing.best_fit: Non-EEA international students who need partial help with study costs in the first year of a Dutch bachelor's or master's programme and who can meet a specific institution's additional requirements.
existing.notes: The award was renamed from 'Holland Scholarship' to 'NL Scholarship'; the same page URL remains the official record. The participating-institution list is refreshed every year by Nuffic.
existing.application_period: Annual cycle; the 2026-2027 academic year opened for applications on 1 November 2025 and each participating institution sets its own closing date and eligible fields of study.
existing.deadline_display: Institution-specific: "Please check the website of the institution you want to apply to for the specific deadline(s)." The official page states the 2026-2027 cycle "opened on 1 November 2025".
existing.program_type: Government-funded partial scholarship (Ministry of Education plus Dutch universities)

scholarships.title: Justus & Louise van Effen Excellence Scholarship

existing.description: The Justus & Louise van Effen Excellence Scholarships are financed by the legacy of Justus and Louise van Effen and administered by TU Delft together with Delft University Fund, with a minimum of 16 awards each year, two per faculty. Awarded students receive full tuition fees per year for a two-year regular TU Delft master's programme, based on the statutory or institutional rate for their nationality, plus a contribution towards living expenses. Applicants must be excellent international students among the top 10% of their graduating class and must submit a complete MSc application, the scholarship application form, a reference letter and an English language certificate by 1 December 2026 (23:59 CET), with results announced by the end of March 2027.
eligibility: Excellent international applicant (conditionally) admitted to a two-year regular TU Delft MSc programme (not an International Joint Education Programme)
Amongst the top 10% of graduates in the previous study programme(s), relevant to the master's programme applied for
Complete MSc application submitted before the scholarship deadline
Not a TU Delft bachelor's student, including international students
Bachelor's degree not obtained at a Dutch university
Not already started MSc studies at TU Delft (for new incoming students only)
existing.eligibility_summary: Excellent international applicants who are (conditionally) admitted to one of the two-year regular TU Delft master's programmes, are among the top 10% of graduates of their previous programme and submit a complete master's application before the scholarship deadline.
benefits: Full tuition fees for the first year
Second-year tuition and living allowance if at least 48 of 60 ECTS are completed
coverage: Full tuition fees per year for a TU Delft MSc programme (statutory or institutional rate by registered nationality)
Second-year support conditional on sufficient study progress (at least 48 of 60 ECTS)
requirements: Complete the MSc application and tick the scholarship option
Submit the English language certificate with the MSc application before the scholarship deadline
documents: Scholarship Application Form 2027-2029 (PDF published by TU Delft)
One reference letter (two references must be merged into one PDF)
English language certificate uploaded with the MSc application before the scholarship deadline
existing.english_requirement: An English language certificate must be uploaded with the MSc application before the scholarship deadline for all applicants who wish to be considered; the required level follows the chosen MSc programme.
application_method: Complete the TU Delft international MSc application
Upload one reference letter and the English language certificate with the application
existing.selection_notes: The university states the scholarships are "extremely limited and highly competitive, with only the strongest candidates selected", and that applications far outnumber the funds available.
existing.best_fit: Non-EU/EEA applicants with a top-decile academic record seeking admission to a two-year regular TU Delft master's programme who can apply within the same round as their MSc application.
existing.notes: TU Delft offers a minimum of 16 of these Excellence Scholarships each year, two per faculty. Reference letters submitted after the scholarship deadline are not accepted, and missing the first deadline means the application is not reviewed.
existing.application_period: One round per year tied to the TU Delft international MSc application; scholarship application form 2027-2029, results emailed by the end of March 2027.
existing.deadline_display: "1 December 2026 (23:59 CET)" for the scholarship round using the Scholarship Application Form 2027-2029.
existing.program_type: University excellence scholarship financed by the Justus & Louise van Effen Fund
